messages.content: The closing meeting now runs until 5:45 Thursday, so the 7:05 nonstop is no longer workable. Compare the late Thursday connection with the Friday-morning nonstop, including the extra hotel night and what each does to Friday work.

The late Thursday option leaves Philadelphia at 8:40 p.m., connects in Charlotte, and reaches DFW at 12:47 a.m. Friday. The fare difference is $67, with no additional hotel cost. It preserves Friday's workday, but the trip takes 5 hours 7 minutes and a modest delay in Philadelphia could jeopardize the connection.

The Friday nonstop leaves at 8:15 a.m. and arrives DFW at 10:49 a.m. Its fare difference is $42. The hotel can add Thursday night for $318.72 including tax, bringing that option's added cost to $360.72. It is the simpler itinerary, but you would be unavailable for most of Friday morning and likely could not be at the office before noon.
What happens with my suitcase in each case? The hotel was only planning to hold it until about 4:30 Thursday.

For the Thursday connection, the hotel will extend the storage note to 6:15 p.m., so you can collect the suitcase immediately after the meeting and go to the airport. That timing leaves roughly two hours before departure.

For the Friday nonstop, you keep the suitcase in the room Thursday and check out early Friday. The hotel does not charge separately for either arrangement.
The Friday option is worth the extra cost. I do not want to finish the meeting and then race into a connection that late. Rebook the return for Friday morning and add the fourth hotel night.

Understood. I will move only the return segment to the Friday nonstop and extend the existing hotel reservation through Friday morning. The Monday flight and the first three hotel nights remain unchanged.
Go ahead and confirm both changes.

Both changes are confirmed. Your return under PHL6N8 is now Friday, November 7, departing PHL at 8:15 a.m. and arriving DFW nonstop at 10:49 a.m. The $42 fare difference was charged to the card on file; the ticket remains nonrefundable and changeable without a change fee, subject to fare difference.

Hotel confirmation PHL-HAM-41872 now covers November 3-7. The added night is $318.72 including tax, making the revised hotel total $1,112.21, payable at the property. The room remains yours Thursday, so the luggage-storage request has been removed. Your Monday outbound, Tuesday briefing, and Wednesday program are unchanged.
